verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule engine that maps events to automatic actions. Configurable risk-score equations and screening configurations are adjacent settings, not event-to-action rules. Webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED are outbound notifications, which belong to a separate story. Auto-escalation and auto-remediation by the agentic workflows are vendor-defined behaviour, and the Starter Plan states its agent configurations cannot be customized.
